errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, revision or directory.

ref.description: The ref or commit shown, as `ref` named it, less any path.

path.description: The directory, from the root; empty for the root.

commits.description: Each commit an entry names, once.

entries.description: Each entry of the directory, in the tree's order.

commitCount.description: How many commits the ref's history holds, its own among them. Only when `path` is the root.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit, which may run on into the path, as dev.knotless.getTree takes it; the default branch if absent.

path.description: A directory in the tree, from its root.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getTree takes it.

main.description: The newest commit to change each entry of a directory at a revision, as its history shows it: a commit that left an entry as one of its parents had it did not change it. Asked apart from dev.knotless.getTree, as finding them can walk a long history. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

sha.description: The commit that last changed it, in hex: one of `commits`.

name.description: The entry's name in the directory.

entry.description: One entry of the directory, and the commit that last changed it.

description: The newest commit to change each entry of a directory.
